tripwires.name: Open the GCC
tripwires.action: Size the GCC from the UAE first and review messaging channels (D14).

tripwires.name: Reopen human handoff
tripwires.action: Reopen C5 scope with the founder and engineer.

tripwires.name: Reopen order and policy answers
tripwires.action: Reopen C6 scope. Positioning against support agents may need rewording.

tripwires.name: Theme rendering issue
tripwires.action: Fix the widget and list the theme on the technical one-pager.

tripwires.name: Speed budget exceeded
tripwires.action: Fix the widget before launch. Never publish a 'no impact' line.

tripwires.name: Conversation definition confusion
tripwires.action: Rewrite the definition on the plan page and listing.

tripwires.name: Pauses drive uninstalls
tripwires.action: Revisit the quota behavior. Never add overage without a decision entry.

tripwires.name: Yearly plans not chosen
tripwires.action: Review the yearly offer at month 6.

tripwires.name: Model cost over the ceiling
tripwires.action: Change the model or prompt before any price changes.

tripwires.name: Founding cohort full early
tripwires.action: If before day 60, open a second cohort of 20.

tripwires.name: Interviews declined
tripwires.action: Rethink the interview incentive or format.

tripwires.name: Partner share review
tripwires.action: Review the 25% and 30% shares against margin.

tripwires.name: Listing underconverts
tripwires.action: Rework the listing: screenshots first, then copy.

tripwires.name: Feedback calls skipped
tripwires.action: Change the call format or cadence.
